name: Chore wheel
summary: Roommates spin a wheel for this week's chores; slices are sized by how many fights each chore caused and nobody doubles up until every chore is taken.
useWhen: roommates deciding who does which chore this week
'who's on dishes', 'spin for chores', 'I did trash last week'
a weekly rota or shift plan for a house, a club or a team
dontUseWhen: picking one person (use a wheel of names)
drafting a month of chores with points (use chore-draft)

params.title: string
params.rule: house rule shown on the result, e.g. Swaps allowed till Sun 8 PM
params.spun: {name, chore label}[] already spun this week
